e.title: QuorumForge（多智能体证据裁决引擎）
e.title_hk: QuorumForge（多智能體證據裁決引擎）
e.summary: 对智能体审议记录做确定性裁决（Rust，MIT）：共识/分歧/争议/无据四带 + 完整性摘要
e.summary_en: Deterministic adjudication over agent deliberation records (Rust, MIT): consensus/split/contested/unsupported bands plus an integrity digest
e.summary_hk: 對智能體審議記錄做確定性裁決（Rust，MIT）：共識/分歧/爭議/無據四帶 + 完整性摘要
e.body: QuorumForge（`VanTaS15/QuorumForge`，Rust 核心，MIT，2020 年建仓、2026-09-05 更新）是一个**多智能体证据裁决引擎**，但它刻意**不做编排**：它不运行 agent、不调用模型、不管提示词，只在辩论结束之后处理**审议记录（record）**——谁支持了什么、谁提出了反对、各自有多确定、引用了什么——并让这些经过一个「加权推理棱镜」，输出四条干净的裁决带：**consensus（共识）/ split（分歧）/ contested（争议）/ unsupported（无据）**。关键性质是**确定性**：同一份证据文件永远得到同一个裁决、同一份报告字节与同一个完整性摘要，因此裁决结果可以提交进版本库、下周再做 diff。实现为 Rust 核心、仅用标准库。对 RIAA：这条思路正对**保险 AI 治理**的软肋——当理赔、核保、产品比较这类流程由多个 agent 分工给出结论时，「**最终结论是怎么从各方意见里得出的、能不能复现、能不能被审计**」往往是最难回答的问题；QuorumForge 把它变成一个可版本化、可复算的对象，与池内几个治理样本正好互补：[[agrisky-ai]] 用 SHA-256 审计回执固定「谁在什么时候批了什么」，[[evidence-review-claims]] 做图像证据裁决，[[phi-boundary-gate]] 做边界门禁，[[insurance-governance]] 记录行业治理标准；评测与可靠性侧另见 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]]、[[agentbench]]。⚠️ 术语提醒：这里的 **claim 指「智能体的断言」，不是保险索赔**——不要按理赔系统理解。适合作 AI 治理、智能体可靠性与审计追踪方向。
e.body_en: QuorumForge (`VanTaS15/QuorumForge`, Rust core, MIT, created 2020, updated 2026-09-05) is a **multi-agent evidence adjudication engine** that deliberately **does not orchestrate**: it does not run agents, call models or manage prompts. It works only on the **record** of a deliberation once the debate is over — who supported what, who pushed back, how confident each was, what they cited — and passes that through a "prism of weighted reasoning" to output four clean verdict bands: **consensus, split, contested and unsupported**. The key property is **determinism**: the same evidence file always yields the same verdict, the same report bytes and the same integrity digest, so a verdict can be committed to version control and diffed next week. It is implemented as a Rust core using only the standard library. For RIAA: this addresses the soft spot of **AI governance in insurance** — when claims, underwriting or product comparison are split across several agents, "**how was the final conclusion derived from their opinions, can it be reproduced, can it be audited**" is often the hardest question to answer; QuorumForge turns it into a versionable, recomputable object, complementing several governance samples in this corpus: [[agrisky-ai]] pins down "who approved what, when" with SHA-256 audit receipts, [[evidence-review-claims]] adjudicates image evidence, [[phi-boundary-gate]] enforces boundary gates, and [[insurance-governance]] records industry governance standards; for evaluation and reliability see [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[garak]] and [[agentbench]]. ⚠️ Terminology note: here **"claim" means an agent’s assertion, not an insurance claim** — do not read this as a claims system. Suits AI governance, agent reliability and audit-trail work.
e.body_hk: QuorumForge（`VanTaS15/QuorumForge`，Rust 核心，MIT，2020 年建倉、2026-09-05 更新）是一個**多智能體證據裁決引擎**，但它刻意**不做編排**：它不運行 agent、不調用模型、不管提示詞，只在辯論結束之後處理**審議記錄（record）**——誰支持了什麼、誰提出反對、各自有多確定、引用了什麼——並讓這些經過一個「加權推理稜鏡」，輸出四條乾淨的裁決帶：**consensus（共識）/ split（分歧）/ contested（爭議）/ unsupported（無據）**。關鍵性質是**確定性**：同一份證據文件永遠得到同一個裁決、同一份報告位元組與同一個完整性摘要，因此裁決結果可以提交進版本庫、下週再做 diff。實現為 Rust 核心、僅用標準庫。對 RIAA：這條思路正對**保險 AI 治理**的軟肋——當理賠、核保、產品比較這類流程由多個 agent 分工給出結論時，「**最終結論是怎麼從各方意見裡得出的、能不能複現、能不能被審計**」往往是最難回答的問題；QuorumForge 把它變成可版本化、可複算的對象，與 [[agrisky-ai]]（SHA-256 審計回執）、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[insurance-governance]] 互補；評測與可靠性側另見 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]]、[[agentbench]]。⚠️ 術語提醒：這裡的 **claim 指「智能體的斷言」，不是保險索賠**。適合作 AI 治理、智能體可靠性與審計追蹤方向。
